These vectors are the JSON files under `testdata/inclusion/` and `testdata/consistency/` of [transparency-dev/merkle](https://github.com/transparency-dev/merkle) at commit `c39fbf350a405f68571bf4c42a6a518eb0a46a4b`, gathered into one array per directory; each element carries its original file name in `file`. Byte fields are base64, as in the source. They are used as data only, under the source's Apache-2.0 license.
